title: Two moons of Jupiter crossed paths
description:
What the astronomers say: Ganymede hid Io for a short time. This is called a mutual occultation, and we only see it when the moon orbits are edge-on, about every six years.
NASA picture: JPL, PIA00600. Galileo and Voyager spacecraft images.
Every day’s picture: https://cosmos.rimilab.com/
The APOD photo of 28 October 2026 is by Michael Wong: https://science.nasa.gov/image-article/apod-2026-october-28-the-mutual-occultation-of-ganymede-and-io/. To use it, please ask the owner.
